channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: The House Freedom Caucus has to transform — it could preview the GOP's post-Trump era
item.description: The conservative House Freedom caucus grew in prominence along side President Trump, now they are considering what the future of their movement looks like.

item.title: Trump heads to U.N. looking for wins after a rough week
item.description: The past couple of weeks have been particularly challenging for Trump with a series of legal and political setbacks.

item.title: Abortion is on the ballot again as post-Roe policies continue to evolve
item.description: Four states will vote on abortion-related ballot measures in November. The measures follow the Supreme Court's "Dobbs" decision, which upended federal abortion protections.

item.title: Outgoing House Democrat backs incumbent Republican lawmaker for re-election
item.description: Outgoing Democratic Rep. Jared Golden of Maine backed incumbent Republican Rep. Mike Lawler of New York for re-election ahead of the midterm election.

item.title: Anxiety grows over emerging election issue, but GOP says Washington isn't the answer
item.description: Sen. Jon Husted and Mike Rogers say data center decisions should stay local, not federal, as 70% of Americans oppose new AI facilities nearby.

item.title: Kirk family may have path around archaic law shielding gov't in police chief’s alleged ‘got you covered’ text
item.description: A key text message from UVU's police chief could help Charlie Kirk's family pierce Utah's governmental immunity shield in their wrongful death claim.

item.title: Trump’s Greenland deal set for signing after months-long fight over US control
item.description: Trump, Denmark and Greenland will sign a historic Arctic security agreement at the U.N., granting the U.S. permanent military rights on the island.

item.title: Mamdani’s ‘mass engagement’ office draws fire over plans to build influence beyond City Hall: ‘NYC is done’
item.description: Zohran Mamdani's Office of Mass Engagement draws fierce criticism after a commissioner with DSA ties outlined plans to build leaders and organize people.

item.title: Pro-life group ramps up NC ground game as report finds fed abortion message gives GOP candidate biggest boost
item.description: Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America says pro-life messages on Roy Cooper's abortion record shifted voters toward Republican Michael Whatley in the North Carolina Senate race.

item.title: Trump to zero-in on Iran nuclear threat, Gaza plan and UN overhaul in world stage speech
item.description: President Donald Trump addresses the United Nations General Assembly amid Iran tensions before pivoting to White House talks with China's Xi Jinping.

item.title: LIZ PEEK: Can Trump Make the UN Great Again despite its globalist agenda?
item.description: A new Gallup poll shows 73% of Americans say the U.N. fails at maintaining peace and security as Trump prepares to address the General Assembly.

item.title: Trump was a 'caged lion' roaring to return to WHCA Dinner ballroom after shooting, Leavitt says
item.description: Karoline Leavitt reveals Trump was "like a caged lion" demanding to return to the ballroom after shots were fired at the WHCA dinner in April.

item.title: Sylvester Stallone reveals what he said to Trump after surprise Hollywood ambassador appointment
item.description: Sylvester Stallone says he learned about Trump's Hollywood ambassador appointment while watching TV and later told the president it was impossible.

item.title: Mamdani tells Trump banned White House outlets are welcome at NYC meeting
item.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani said the city welcomed all members of the media during his joint press conference with President Trump, who defended his decision to bar certain outlets.

item.title: Socialist, communist groups coordinate, promote 'spontaneous' anti-ICE protests in Austin
item.description: Austin, Tex., ICE shooting protest was organized by socialist and communist groups within hours, not a "spontaneous" gathering as media reported.

item.title: Chris Murphy calls for 'regulating the internet' so people won't fall for a 'demagogue like Donald Trump'
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy claimed regulating the internet could prevent Americans from falling for leaders like President Donald Trump by tackling loneliness.

item.title: Trumpeter Dr Jesse McGuire belts national anthem after instrument malfunctions in unforgettable MLB moment
item.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks' 2001 World Series anniversary featured a trumpet malfunction that turned into an unforgettable national anthem moment.

item.title: Immigrants with final deportation orders disappear from ICE detainee locator
item.description: The change will make it harder for many families and attorneys to determine where an immigrant is being held after being taken into ICE custody.

item.title: Man shot by ICE says he was put in detention with bullet lodged near spine
item.description: Wilber Garcés Pérez said he was rushed out of a hospital and forced to sleep on the floor of an ICE detention center within hours of being shot in Texas.

item.title: Tropical Storm Fay tracker: Map and projected storm path
item.description: Fay is the 6th named storm of the hurricane season
